title: US war on Iran: Reactions in Israel as Trump’s address 'barely' mention ally
summary: Iran responded to US President Donald Trump’s address to Americans on the war with new missile attacks targeting Israel and the Gulf Arab states Thursday, underlining Tehran’s insistence that it rejected Washington’s outreach for a ceasefire while maintaining its grip on the Strait of Hormuz. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.
